column1: # Alpha-plane tune A/B: Tune::Psychovisual (ravif alpha default) vs Tune::Psnr -- 2026-07-03 -- zenavif@87d6e090, zenrav1e local master 165e83b1 (0.2.0)
# Motivation: libavif v1.4.0 switched alpha SSIM->PSNR ('AOM_TUNE_SSIM causes ringing for alpha'); zenavif encodes alpha with Psychovisual (imazen/zenavif#28)

# Harness: scratch crate (path-dep zenrav1e), 512x512 Cs400 stills, speed preset 4, still_picture, min_quantizer=quantizer; decode aomdec 3.14.1; ring zone = flat(5x5 min==max) pixels within Chebyshev<=6 of an edge (4-nbr grad>8), excluding edge pixels

# q71 = ravif alpha default (quality 80). VERDICT (preliminary, synthetic): high-amplitude flat-zone ringing (ring_max 41-72, maxerr 111-189) appears under Psychovisual on mask content at q>=96 (+hard_shapes q48); Psnr suppresses it (ring_max<=6 in 6/8 shape cells) but has its own outliers (aa_shapes q48 maxerr 110; low-amplitude dither cnt at q128). Both tunes clean at default q71. Phenomenon CONFIRMED, default flip NOT yet justified -- needs real-corpus alpha A/B on the ravif encode path (blocked on qmdist dev-patch state 2026-07-03).
